site_brief.title: Super for creators and coaches turning conversations into content and operations

summary: A conversion‑focused niche landing page for creators and coaches who want to turn calls, DMs, and voice notes into repeatable content and real operations. The page reuses Super’s successful comparison‑page architecture, positions Super as a sharper alternative to chat‑first tools, and grounds its claims in current reporting on computer‑use agents, workflow automation, and security risks.
